articles.title: Monarch Mosaic

Cells have fan-like radial shading, like cut glass or scale armour; the layout is dense with no clear gaps. From a distance: A glittering amber-orange texture with rusty red freckles; reads as orange-gold with a rough, shimmering grain. Measured spec (average): metal 57, roughness 154, coat 57.
